findings.issue: Route totals exclude quest time. Every quest step carries 0 hours because no verified fact gives quest durations (plan assumption; no quest step has est_hours). Safest has 2 quest steps (S01, S02); balanced 7 (S01-S06, S12). The 228.2 / 222.86 h totals are training hours only.
findings.recommendation: The guide must state next to every route total: "route totals exclude quest time" and label the totals as training hours.

findings.owner: writer/editor (strategist for wording of the route comparison)
findings.issue: The safest-vs-balanced gap (228.2 - 222.86 = 5.34 h) is not a like-for-like time saving. It decomposes into 4.29 h from Rellekka instead of Pollnivneach at 80-90 (S13 67.193 h vs S11 71.479 h) and 1.05 h less Falador training (S08 1.046 h vs 2.096 h) because five extra quests (S03, S04, S05, S06, S12) add 28,562 Agility XP at 0 hours. If those quests take more than about 1.05 h in total, the quest block costs time rather than saving it; if they take more than about 5.34 h, balanced is slower overall than safest. No fact gives their durations, so the direction of the comparison cannot be confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Do not present balanced as '5.3 h faster' than safest. Present training hours only, show the decomposition (Rellekka 80-90 saves about 4.3 h of training; the quest block replaces about 1.05 h of Falador training plus unknown quest time), and justify the extra quests by their other value (Rellekka lyre access, Tirannwn, quest Defence) rather than by time.

plan_numeric_sha256 covers only step numeric keys, route step lists, target and start_xp. calc.json also copies prose from the plan (levels[].method = step method/title). A future prose-only plan edit to a method/title would leave those labels stale in calc.json without changing the numeric hash or failing validate. Today they match: an in-process re-run of tools/xp.py simulate_route on plan v5 reproduces calc.json routes exactly, labels included.
findings.recommendation: Writer should take step titles/methods from plan.json, not from calc.json levels rows; or re-emit calc after any method/title edit.

findings.issue: Profit is valued at the Amylase crystal MID price 548 (snapshot 2026-11-22T03:39Z, high 608, low 487). Mid is not a price anyone gets: selling instantly at the low (487) gives 16.00M (safest) / 15.68M (balanced) instead of 18.01M / 17.65M (-11.1%); a patient sell at the high (608) gives 19.98M / 19.58M (+10.9%). gp/h is 78.9k / 79.2k at mid, about 70.2k at 487 and 87.5k at 608. xp.py uses mid for every item by design (_price).
findings.recommendation: The guide must say every profit figure is 'at mid price (548 gp per crystal), snapshot date 2026-11-22' and show the 487-608 band (about 16.0-20.0M safest, 15.7-19.6M balanced). Do not present a single GP total as achievable.

findings.issue: Market depth is ample. Selling needs 97-160 crystals/h (about 9.7-16 marks/h x 10), against 24h volume 98,140 (about 4,089/h): 2.4%-3.9% of hourly volume. Whole route is about 32,859 (safest) / 32,200 (balanced) crystals, roughly one third of one day's volume spread over 223-228 h, and well under the 11,000 per 4 h buy limit when sold in daily batches. Not thin (threshold 500). Volume is a single 24h figure; no fact gives the longer-term trend.
findings.recommendation: State that depth is not a constraint for one player, but that the price is a one-day snapshot and amylase is tied to stamina-potion demand; recheck before relying on it.

findings.issue: Income assumes every mark of grace is converted to amylase and sold, but the plan also says marks buy Graceful (S09 note; 260 marks, F-1121; assumption says Graceful is not modelled). Marks spent on Graceful are not sold: 260 marks = 26 packs = 2,600 crystals = about 1.42M gp at mid (about 8% of the 18.0M) that would not be earned. calc.json does not deduct it.
findings.recommendation: Label the profit as 'if all marks are sold' and either subtract about 1.42M gp when the player buys Graceful or state it as an opportunity cost.

findings.issue: Profit is not net of the Grand Exchange tax or any selling fee: no fact in facts.json gives a Hardcore Worlds GE tax, and prices.json does not either, so none was applied. If a tax exists, real proceeds are lower. Profit also counts training hours only (Q-01), and mark rates are the LOW end of each fact's range and the base rate without diaries (conservative); Q-03 means S09 may run longer and yield slightly more marks.
findings.recommendation: Say 'before any GE tax' unless a verified fact is added.
